note: SWIFT's IBAN Registry, the column for Poland, as the copy gives it. The registry gives no bank identifier inside the BBAN, so no part of the number stays the same from one account to the next at a bank. A national check inside the BBAN, where the country has one, isn't in the registry and isn't modelled: a number drawn here passes the IBAN's own check. Release 103 (September 2026) is SWIFT's current; changes since this copy aren't read.
